cases.prompt: A person walks forward at a relaxed, steady pace.
A person walks forward slowly with heavy, deliberate footfalls and pronounced weight shifts.
A person limps forward, keeping weight off the left leg and taking short uneven steps.
A person takes a short run-up and jumps lightly over a low obstacle, landing smoothly on both feet.
A person approaches a low obstacle cautiously, bends deeply, jumps over it with visible effort and regains balance after landing.

scope: First round: text-only comparisons, five behaviors and three fixed seeds. No obstacle geometry constraints yet. These prompts describe physical motion; robot identity is supplied by later retargeting.
